message:
test(rel-0164): the capability's single use is judged only after the fake directory has stopped re-handing the same token (verifier: 176/177 once at 53fced4)

The fake's last scripted reply repeats, so every heartbeat handed the SAME capability token out again, and the punch
flood just before asks for a refresh. A heartbeat landing between the two AuthorizePeer calls re-installed the consumed
token and the second call passed: "...and the capability is single use" failed by timing. The real directory issues a
new token per connect, so this was the fake, not the product. Now the heartbeat is re-scripted without a capability and
the judgement waits (bounded 8 s) for one heartbeat served that way -- the agent's heartbeats are sequential, so every
earlier token-bearing reply has been taken in -- and the heartbeats between the two calls are recorded. A contrast
shows the mechanism on purpose: put the token-bearing reply back, one heartbeat later the consumed token is accepted.
Before: 0 of 20 runs reproduced here (the verifier saw 1 of 4). After: 10/10 (178 checks), with the contrast 3/3 and
10 more runs (179 checks).

Test only: no product code changed.
